rehomed.assertion: The storage area itself scopes state to the theme, the user and, within the workspace, the workspace, and keeps it in memory while the storage is blocked; the kit asserts these on its port of the area (test/storage-port.ts).

rewritten: E3g keeps the record in the SDK storage area (seen-deliverables, in this browser, for the user in this workspace): readSeen and writeSeen take no scope, readSeen says whether the host is ready, writeSeen says whether the host kept the record, parseSeen reads a stored value rather than JSON text, and the move of a record kept before F5 went with the old keys (E1), so that case now asserts an old record is not read.
